artists.biography:
Spin Doctors is an American alternative rock band formed in New York City, best known for their early 1990s hits, "Two Princes", and "Little Miss Can't Be Wrong", which peaked on the Billboard Hot 100 chart at #7 and #17 respectively.
The current members are Chris Barron (vocals), Eric Schenkman (guitar and vocals), Aaron Comess (drums and percussion), and Mark White (bass guitar).

perplexity.description:
Pocket Full of Kryptonite is the debut studio album by American rock band Spin Doctors, released in August 1991 on Epic Records. The album blends elements of rock, pop, and jam band styles, characterized by catchy guitar riffs, energetic rhythms, and bluesy undertones. Its sound is rooted in the early '90s alternative rock scene, with tracks like "Little Miss Can't Be Wrong" and "Two Princes" showcasing the band's knack for memorable hooks and playful lyrics. The album's title, referencing Superman mythology, reflects its quirky, pop-culture-inspired themes.

As the band's first major release, Pocket Full of Kryptonite established Spin Doctors as a prominent act in the rock landscape of the early 1990s. It achieved significant commercial success, eventually selling over 5 million copies in the United States, driven by the popularity of its hit singles. While the band's subsequent albums did not reach the same level of acclaim, this debut remains their most recognized and influential work. The album's blend of accessible rock and jam band sensibilities helped define the sound of the era and solidified Spin Doctors' place in rock history.
